answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies of the university, including the senate.
The budget planning round is a central body for funds allocation, and the president leads the university.
Appointment committees deal with professorships at the faculty level, not as part of the president's direct central body jurisdiction.
The faculty council handles the affairs of one faculty, whereas the president leads the entire university.
The study commission operates at the faculty level.
The examination board decides on individual examination matters within a faculty.
The internal research funding round is a faculty-level body.
The module revision working group operates at the degree programme level within a faculty.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled at the faculty or department level.
Orientation week planning is organized at the faculty or student body level.
